text: You just read okay, with a period... fourteen times. And every time, it sounded colder.
Psychologists tested this. Students tried to get sarcastic or serious sentences across to a partner. Half of them used their voice. The other half typed.
The listeners got about three out of four right. The readers... no better than a coin flip. And the readers felt just as sure.
In a bigger study, friends were no more accurate than strangers. Because text has no voice. So your brain supplies one. Usually... the one you're afraid of.
So read it again in the warmest voice you can. Or just ask. Or call.
That okay, with a period? It probably meant... okay.
What's the shortest text that ever sent you spiraling?
